cohort: 27,176 very preterm infants (<32 weeks gestational age or birth weight <1500 g) at low risk of early-onset sepsis from the Chinese Neonatal Network (CHNN)
finding: Prolonged early antibiotic exposure (5-7 days) and use of broad-spectrum antibiotics were associated with an increased risk of moderate to severe BPD or mortality in very preterm infants at low risk of early-onset sepsis.
